items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Tramon; the mention of Tramon occurs entirely within the interviewer's turns ('And them trump and stuff, and Tramon talk like that', 'Tramon's talking about').

ctx.x: People would still be there every time. No, I ain't going to do it. Sure. And you talk about nothing, boy. People used to walk from camp to camp. Sure. Right. You want to be promenading all night. All night and night.

Your friend got campers that you invite you and your wife or some of your friends. Sure. Come to our camp, our band. Now you walk in, just all night, camp and stuff. And them trump and stuff, and Tramon talk like that. Pa, pa, pa, pa, pa, man. You can just give them.
